objective: Validate the exact selected alert before separately assessing bounded grouped history, preserving event-level attribution and refusing to project the latest group member onto earlier or later observations.
preconditions: an exact selected alert identity and trusted timestamp exist
group membership criteria and bounded group window are attributable
deployed alert-context field catalog is available
required_evidence: exact selected event identity timestamp rule identity and tuple
grouping dimensions and the identity of each grouped observation considered
successful query coverage row count truncation and evidence references

query_templates.purpose: Retrieve the exact trusted alert anchor and its event-native identity before interpreting any aggregate or group history.
Drill down from bounded grouping dimensions to individual alert documents without treating the newest member as representative of the group.

alternative_hypotheses: one selected event is benign while other group members differ materially
a repeated benign service or approved test explains the group
the grouping dimensions combine unrelated event tuples or assets
a consistent malicious campaign explains independently corroborated members
stop_conditions: the selected event and every relied-on group member have attributable evidence
grouping ambiguity prevents a group-wide conclusion and is reported as unverified
the next bounded drilldown has low expected information value
a query budget or deadline is exhausted
confidence_limiters: group criteria or document identities are unavailable
the grouped view exposes only the newest member
the bounded window omits earlier or later group observations
query coverage or truncation prevents complete group assessment
known_false_positive_patterns: repeated health checks or service discovery
multiple unrelated assets sharing a broad rule name

references.title: Security Onion 2.4 Alerts grouped and detailed views
